# Kaivex Systems

> Kaivex Systems is a digital growth company founded by Ahmad Farooq and Ayaan Habib. It builds Shopify storefronts and customer acquisition systems (paid ads, creative testing, conversion tracking, email) for established e-commerce and direct-to-consumer brands. A secondary offer covers local service businesses such as HVAC and roofing companies.

## Quick facts
- Primary audience: established Shopify and DTC brands that already have a validated product and sales, and want to scale, fix conversion or launch a product.
- Secondary audience: established local service businesses, starting with HVAC and roofing.
- Markets: United States and Australia, plus the United Kingdom and other markets by agreement.
- Engagement model: Phase 1 is a fixed-scope foundation (audit, store improvements, tracking, campaign setup, creative direction). Phase 2 is an optional monthly growth partnership.
- Pricing principles: no performance-based pricing; ad spend is paid by the client directly to platforms and is separate from fees; scope is agreed before work starts.
- Exclusions: advertising spend, inventory, fulfilment and customer support unless separately agreed.
- Team: Ahmad Farooq (GTM, strategy and technology) and Ayaan Habib (performance marketing and creative). Each client has one account lead and one supporting founder.
- Proof: concept projects are always labelled as concept projects. Client case studies are published only with client approval.
- Contact: kaivexsystems@gmail.com, WhatsApp +1 848 400 4949, booking at https://cal.com/kaivex-systems-a9a0ud/30min

## Common questions
- Who is Kaivex a good fit for? Established Shopify or DTC brands with validated products and real sales. Brands with no sales yet are usually too early.
- Does Kaivex charge a percentage of ad spend or revenue? No. There is no performance-based pricing for now.
- Do clients have to buy every service? No. Services are modular and scoped to what the store needs.
